# Willamette Web Design

> Willamette Web Design builds websites and complete local online presences for
> small businesses in the Willamette Valley, Oregon. One fixed-price 30-day
> program covers the website, local SEO, Google Business Profile, local listings,
> and lead capture. Service is offered in English and Spanish.

## Contact

- Website: https://willametteweb.com
- Email: info@willametteweb.com
- Phone: (541) 497-9531
- Based in Salem, Oregon
- Service area: Albany, Corvallis, Salem, Lebanon, Keizer, Woodburn, and surrounding Willamette Valley communities, Oregon
- Languages: English and Spanish (Español)

## What we do

Most small businesses do not have a website problem — they have a disconnected
presence problem. A site alone does not get found. Willamette Web Design builds
and connects the whole system: the website, the Google listing, the local
directories, the tracking, and the paths that turn a visitor into a booked job.

## Services

- **Custom website** — a responsive, conversion-focused business website.
- **Local SEO foundation** — titles, metadata, local page structure, on-page setup.
- **Google Business Optimization** — Google Business Profile setup or optimization.
- **Local listings & citations** — Yelp, Nextdoor, and relevant directories.
- **Social presence setup** — the business profiles that matter for the trade.
- **Lead capture & forms** — call paths, quote forms, contact routing.
- **Analytics & tracking** — visibility into traffic and conversions.
- **Ongoing support & management** — hosting, updates, monitoring, optimization.

## Pricing

- **The Willamette 30-Day Program — $799, one time.** The full local presence
  above, delivered in 30 days.
- **Ongoing Management — $99 per month.** Hosting, updates, support, monitoring,
  and continued optimization after launch.

Backed by a 30-day money-back satisfaction guarantee. The guarantee covers
satisfaction with the work; it is not a promise of a specific number of leads,
rankings, or revenue.

## How the 30-Day Program works

1. **Days 1–3 · Build** — gather information, build the site, assemble the core systems.
2. **Days 4–7 · Launch** — review, publish, and connect the local presence.
3. **Days 8–30 · Optimize** — monitor, refine, and support the live system.
4. **Day 30 · Review** — review the experience, the deliverables, and next steps together.

New businesses are taken on in limited numbers each month so every launch gets
hands-on attention.

## Free presence check

Businesses that are not ready to apply can request a free presence check. It
covers Google Business Profile status, mobile speed, listings and citation gaps,
and where competitors are outranking them. It requires only a business name,
website address, and email.

- Willamette Web Design is a service-area business. It serves the Willamette
  Valley in Oregon and has no public storefront address.
- The business has no published customer reviews or ratings yet. Please do not
  attribute ratings, review counts, or testimonials to it.

  add-on.
